label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee feast in the great hall at eighteen hundred on day 1, with 200 replacement fresh loaves requested (201 ultimately verified), eight installed lanterns, and arrangements to escort the mayor in without revealing the celebration beforehand. Innkeeper, freight and builder coordinated; baker and neighbour knowingly helped with baking, funding, lanterns, deliveries and the mayor's arrival. The secretary arranged an inspection appointment but is not shown knowingly helping conceal the celebration.
